name: Ryoyu Systems Co., Ltd.
summary: Ryoyu Systems Co., Ltd. provides design, development, operation and maintenance of information and communication systems for various industries in Japan. The company offers system development services for production management systems; system maintenance/operation/monitoring services, including design of information systems and communication networks; and IT infrastructure construction services comprising planning, design, construction, and operation of IT platforms, such as computers, peripherals, network devices, and communication cables.
